item.title: Joint Rally of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academy Alumni Associations at National Assembly: "Stop the Integration of Service Academies" (육·해·공사 총동창회 국회 궐기대회 “사관학교 통합 중단하라”)
item.description:
The alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies held a "Rally Against the Integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies and the Relocation of the Army Academy" on the 8th, demanding that the government halt its policy of integrating the service academies. While reserve officers and others had been holding solo protests against the integration in front of the Ministry of National Defense in Seoul, this marks the first time the alumni associations of all three academies have taken collective action on the issue of service academy integration. (육군·해군·공군사관학교 총동창회가 8일 ‘육·해·공군사관학교 통합 육사 지방 이전 반대 궐기대회’(궐기대회)를 열고 정부의 사관학교 통합 정책 추진 중단을 요구했다. 그동안 예비역 장교 등이 서울 국방부 앞에서 통합 반대 1인 시위를 해왔지만, 육·해·공사 총동창회가 사관학교 통합 문제와 관련해 집단행동에 나선 것은 이날이 처음이다.)

On the morning of the 8th, in front of the main building of the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, the joint alumni association of the three academies held the rally alongside Rep. Han Ki-ho of the People Power Party, an Army Academy graduate, Rep. Im Jong-deuk of the People Power Party, and the parents' association of Army Academy cadets, calling for a halt to the integration plan and a full reconsideration from scratch. As assemblies and protests are not allowed within the National Assembly grounds, the event was held in the format of a press conference by lawmakers. Participants included 42 organizations, including former Army Academy superintendents, and reserve generals. The organizers stated that about 2,000 people attended. (육·해·공사 총동창회는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회 본관 앞에서 육사 출신인 한기호 국민의힘 의원, 임종득 국민의힘 의원, 육사 생도 학부모 모임 등과 함께 궐기대회를 개최하고 사관학교 통합 추진 중단과 원점 재검토를 요구했다. 국회 경내 집회·시위가 불가능해 이날 행사는 국회의원 기자회견 형식으로 열렸다. 역대 육사 교장단을 비롯한 42개 단체와 예비역 장군 등이 참여했다. 주최 쪽은 이날 2천여명이 참석했다고 밝혔다.)

In a resolution announced at the rally, the joint alumni association asserted, "The merger of the service academies and the relocation of the Army Academy are major national issues that could affect the history, traditions, identity, expertise of the armed forces, and overall national security." They argued, "While such matters should be pursued based on objective verification, public consensus, and social agreement, the government is pushing forward hastily, ignoring these prerequisites." They insisted that if reform of the service academies is necessary, a consultative body involving military experts, senior military figures, education professionals, and parents of academy cadets should be formed to design the policy openly and objectively. (육·해·공사 총동창회는 궐기대회에서 결의문을 발표해 “사관학교 통폐합과 육사 지방 이전은 국군의 역사와 전통, 정체성과 전문성, 국가안보 전반에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 중대한 국가적 현안”이라며 “객관적인 검증과 국민적 공감대, 사회적 합의를 바탕으로 추진돼야 함에도 정부가 이를 무시한 채 졸속으로 추진하고 있다”고 주장했다. 이들은 사관학교 개혁이 필요하다면 군사 전문가와 군 원로, 교육계, 사관생도 학부모 등이 참여하는 협의기구를 구성해 공개적이고 객관적으로 정책을 설계해야 한다고 주장했다.)

Park Pan-joon, President of the Army Academy Alumni Association, stated, "The merger of the service academies pursued by the government does not contribute to strengthening joint operations or recruiting excellent cadets." He added, "National security should not be an object of experimentation, and certainly not a political sacrifice." (박판준 육사 총동창회장은 “정부가 추진하는 사관학교 통폐합은 합동성 강화나 우수 생도 모집에 도움이 되지 않는다”며 “안보는 실험 대상이 돼선 안 되고 정치적 제물이 되어선 더더욱 안 된다”고 말했다.)

Kim Yo-hwan, a former Chief of Staff of the Army, argued, "If we consider the future of the nation and the military, what is urgent is improving the service conditions for military officers and creating an environment where talented individuals can choose the military with pride, ahead of any integration or relocation of service academies." (김요환 전 육군참모총장은 “국가와 군의 미래를 생각한다면 사관학교 통합 이전보다 먼저 군 간부 복무 여건을 개선하고 우수 인재들이 자부심을 갖고 군을 선택할 환경을 만드는 게 시급하다”고 주장했다.)

The secretaries-general of the Navy and Air Force Academy alumni associations also expressed their opposition to the integration during the rally. The Navy Academy Alumni Association argued, "Naval cadets must grow up seeing the sea and smelling the ocean air," claiming that "the integration of the academies could undermine the expertise and identity of naval officers." The Air Force Academy Alumni Association also contended that the integration plan currently under discussion would make it "very difficult to train elite officers specialized in the air and space environment." (해·공사 총동창회 사무총장들도 궐기대회에서 발언을 통해 사관학교 통합 반대 입장을 밝혔다. 해사 총동창회는 “해군사관생도는 바다를 보고 바다의 냄새를 맡으며 성장해야 한다”며 “사관학교 통합이 해군 장교 전문성과 정체성을 훼손할 수 있다”고 주장했다. 공사 총동창회도 논의 중인 통합 방안으로는 “공중·우주 환경에 특화된 정예 장교 양성이 매우 어렵다”고 주장했다.)

The Ministry of National Defense is pursuing a plan to establish a "National Defense Academy" to jointly select cadets for the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies in order to strengthen the joint operations capabilities of the military. The plan envisions cadets receiving common education in their first and second years, then choosing their respective service branches in their third and fourth years for specialized branch-specific education. (국방부는 군의 합동성 강화 등을 위해 ‘국군사관학교’를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하는 방안을 추진 중이다. 1·2학년엔 함께 공통 교육을 받고, 3·4학년엔 각 군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 한다는 구상이다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cho Kyung-tae: "For General Election Victory, Expel Jang Dong-hyuk from Party"… Files Complaint to Party Ethics Committee (조경태 “총선 승리 위해 장동혁 제명·출당해달라”…당 윤리위 제소)
item.description:
Cho Kyung-tae, the most senior member (sixth term) of the People Power Party, stated on the 3rd, "For the survival of the party and victory in the next general election, I strongly request the party ethics committee to decide on the expulsion and removal of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk from the party." (국민의힘 최다선(6선)인 조경태 의원이 3일 “당의 생존과 차기 총선 승리를 위해 당 윤리위가 장동혁 대표에 대한 제명 및 출당 처분을 결단해 줄 것을 강력히 요청한다”고 밝혔다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly Communication Center on the same day, Cho said, "In all my years, this is the first time I've seen a party leader who, despite losing an election, brazenly clings to his position until the end." He cited the reasons for filing the complaint against Jang with the ethics committee, including "defeat in the June 3 local elections, a trip to the US that is unacceptable ahead of the election and which abandoned the party leader's responsibilities, undermining the rule of law—a conservative value—by denying the judicial branch's ruling on the former president who incited insurrection, and damaging internal democracy through arbitrary disciplinary politics." <<> In response, Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon met with reporters and said, "We view the filing of a complaint with the ethics committee against the party leader by a party member with great regret," and added, "The matters related to Rep. Cho will be reviewed fairly and impartially by the ethics committee through party procedures." <<> Previously, Cho had requested Democratic Party lawmakers to vote against Rep. Park Deok-heum, who was elected as the National Assembly Vice Speaker candidate for the People Power Party through internal primaries, labeling him as "an insurrection-supporting force." This led to Cho being reported to the party ethics committee for such actions. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (조 의원은 이날 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 “살다살다 당 대표란 분이 선거에서 패배했는데도 불구하고 끝까지 자리를 버티는 후안무치한 모습은 처음 본다”며 이렇게 말했다. 그는 장 대표를 윤리위에 제소하는 이유로 “6·3지방선거 패배, 선거를 앞두고 납득할 수 없는 미국 출장으로 당 대표의 책임을 저버린 것, 내란을 일으킨 전임 대통령에 대한 사법부 판단을 부정해 보수의 가치인 법치주의를 훼손한 것, 독선적 징계정치로 당내 민주주의를 훼손한 것” 등을 들었다.)

item.title: President Lee 'Rows Viking' with Norway's PM, Says "Congratulations on Reaching World Cup Quarterfinals" (이 대통령, 노르웨이 총리에 ‘바이킹 노젓기’ 하며 “월드컵 8강 축하”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently visiting Türkiye for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, held a summit meeting with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre on the 8th (local time), discussing cooperation measures in areas such as economy and defense. (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 참석을 계기로 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 8일(현지시각) 요나스 가르 스퇴르 노르웨이 총리와 정상회담을 하고 경제, 국방 등 분야에서 협력 방안을 논의했다.)

During the South Korea-Norway summit held at a hotel in Türkiye, President Lee stated, "Given the current highly unstable international situation, where overcoming this crisis on a national level is inevitably very limited, I believe that cooperation and exchange between countries are very important at times like this." ( 이 대통령은 이날 튀르키예의 한 호텔에서 열린 한-노르웨이 정상회담에서 “현재 국제 정세가 매우 불안정한 상태여서 각 국가 단위로 이 위기를 극복하기에는 매우 제한적일 수밖에 없는 때일수록 국가 간 협력과 교류가 매우 중요하다고 생각한다”고 말했다. )

President Lee added, "South Korea and Norway are developing into a very deep relationship, providing significant mutual assistance in the areas of economy, industry, culture, and defense," and expressed, "I hope we can have a truly in-depth discussion during our bilateral talks about which areas we can further deepen our relationship in the future." ( 이 대통령은 이어 “대한민국과 노르웨이는 경제, 산업, 문화, 국방 영역에서 서로 큰 도움을 주고받는 매우 깊은 관계로 발전하고 있다”며 “양자 회담에서 우리가 앞으로 어떤 분야에서 어떤 관계를 더 깊게 만들어갈 수 있을지 정말 깊이 있게 논의했으면 좋겠다”고 덧붙였다. )

Prime Minister Støre also expressed familiarity, saying, "We met last year at the G20 summit, and now we meet again." Prime Minister Støre recalled, "I have good memories of having many conversations with you about the bilateral relationship during last year's dinner, and since then, there has been much development in the potential between Norway and South Korea," adding, "We are continuing to advance in the areas of security, trade, and technology." This appears to reference Hanwha Aerospace's full-package supply contract with Norway earlier this year, worth a total of $922 million (1.3 trillion won), including multiple rocket launchers (Chunmoo) and guided missiles. <<> Before the meeting, President Lee greeted Prime Minister Støre, saying, "Congratulations on advancing to the World Cup quarterfinals and also on the submarine selection." Norway defeated Brazil 2-1 in the Round of 16 on the 6th to advance to the quarterfinals. Prime Minister Støre said, "This is the first time we've achieved such a high World Cup result since 1998, and winning against Brazil is also very gratifying," adding, "We have a match against England on Saturday; we'll have to see how it goes, but I believe it will go well." <<> In response, President Lee made the Norwegian 'Viking rowing' gesture, clenching his fists and mimicking rowing motions, and said, "I saw a promotional video Norway made after the Round of 16 match, and it was very good. I hope you row one more time." <<> Ankara/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 스퇴르 총리도 “지난해 주요 20개국(G20) 정상회의를 계기로 뵙고 다시 만나게 됐다”며 친근감을 표했다. 스퇴르 총리는 “지난해 만찬 때 대통령님과 양국 관계에 대해 많은 대화를 나눴던 좋은 기억이 나는데, 그 이후 노르웨이와 한국 간 잠재성에서 많은 발전이 있었다”며 “안보, 교역, 기술 분야에서 (양국이) 계속 나아가고 있다”고 말했다. 한화에어로스페이스가 올해 초 노르웨이에 다연장 로켓 천무와 유도 미사일 등 총 9억2200만달러(1조3천억원) 규모의 풀패키지 공급 계약을 체결한 것 등을 언급한 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: People Power Party invokes ‘Jang Yun-gi case’ in demand to preserve prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers (국힘, ‘장윤기 사건’ 언급하며 검찰 보완수사권 유지 요구)
item.description:

item.title: “Reviving Absentee Voting Is a Deterioration” vs “Just Hold Main Voting for Two Days”…National Assembly Special Committee Debate (“부재자 투표 부활은 개악” vs “본투표 이틀 하면 돼”…국조특위 토론회)
item.description:
At an expert forum held on the 8th by the 'National Assembly Special Committee on the Parliamentary Ballot Shortage Incident' (Special Committee), sharp disagreements over the advance voting system emerged. Those in favor of retaining advance voting argued, “If abolished, voter turnout will drop, which actually infringes on the right to vote,” while those advocating for its abolition countered, “Advance voting violates the principle of universal suffrage and infringes on the right to vote.” (‘국회 투표용지 부족사태 국정조사특위’(국조특위)가 8일 개최한 전문가 간담회에서 사전투표제를 둘러싼 이견이 팽팽히 오갔다. 사전투표 존치론 쪽은 “폐지하면 투표율이 낮아져 오히려 참정권이 침해된다”고 했고, 폐지론 쪽은 “사전투표는 보통선거 원칙에 위배되고 참정권을 침해한다”고 맞섰다.)

Jung Tae-ho, an emeritus professor at Kyung Hee University’s Law School, stated, “There is no perfect voting or vote-counting system in the world. While problems with the advance voting system can be pointed out, reverting to the past now would mean turning back the efforts to actualize universal suffrage.” He maintained a stance in favor of keeping the system. Ryu Jong-ryul, who claimed to have researched election fraud allegations, said, “Advance voting was introduced to address the problems of absentee voting. If absentee voting is revived and advance voting is abolished, it would be a deterioration.” Absentee voting involves a complex process where voters must apply two to three weeks in advance, receive a ballot and return envelope sent by registered mail from the election commission, and sign for them in person. Ryu noted, “With advance voting, you can vote anytime just by bringing your ID.” (정태호 경희대 법학전문대학원 명예교수는 “세상에 완벽한 투·개표 제도는 없다. 사전투표 제도의 문제점을 지적할 수 있지만, 이제 와서 과거로 돌아간다면 보통선거 실질화 노력을 과거로 되돌리는 것”이라며 제도 유지 입장을 밝혔다. 부정선거론를 연구해왔다는 류종렬씨는 “부재자 투표의 문제점을 개선하기 위해 사전투표를 도입했는데, 부재자 투표가 부활하고 사전투표를 폐지한다면 개악”이라고 말했다. 부재자 투표는 유권자가 2∼3주 전에 신청해야 하고 선관위가 등기로 보낸 투표용지와 회송용 봉투를 신청자가 직접 받아야 하는 등 절차가 복잡하다. 류씨는 “사전투표는 신분증만 들고 가면 언제든 투표할 수 있다”고 했다.)

In contrast, Cha Jin-ah, a professor at Korea University’s Law School, argued, “To prevent undue influence on voters, election campaigning is prohibited on election day, but it is allowed during advance voting. If a candidate withdraws after advance voting has already taken place, those votes become invalid.” She stated, “Advance voting violates the principle of universal suffrage and infringes on the right to vote.” Professor Cha proposed a system of “abolishing advance voting and holding main voting over two days.” (반면, 차진아 고려대 법학전문대학원 교수는 “유권자에게 영향 미치는 것을 차단하기 위해 선거일에는 선거운동을 못하는데, 사전투표일에는 할 수 있다. 사전투표하고 후보자가 사퇴하면 그 표는 무효표가 된다”며 “사전투표는 보통선거 원칙에 위배되고 참정권을 침해한다”고 말했다. 차 교수는 ‘사전투표 폐지와 본투표 이틀’ 방식을 제안했다.)

Moon Sang-boo, a senior advisor at the law firm Daehwa Asia, also suggested, “We can incorporate the advantages of advance voting into main voting by holding it over two days and abolishing advance voting,” proposing that the first day of main voting be operated in advance voting style. Lee Hee-beom, CEO of the Korea NGO Council, raised suspicions that “advance voting always gives a specific political party an absolute advantage.” (문상부 법무법인 대륙아주 고문도 “사전투표 장점을 본투표에 담아 이틀 동안 본투표를 하고, 사전투표를 폐지하면 된다”며 본투표 첫날을 사전투표 방식으로 운영하는 방안을 제시했다. 이희범 한국엔지오(NGO)상임연합 대표는 “사전투표는 절대적으로 항상 특정 정당이 우위에 있다”는 의혹을 제기했다.)

The Special Committee plans to hold another expert forum next week to discuss structural reforms of the National Election Commission and election management system reforms, with the aim of producing an election management system reform proposal by the 22nd. (국조특위는 다음주 중 전문가 간담회를 한차례 더 열어 중앙선거관리위원회 구조 개혁과 선거관리 제도 개혁안을 논의하고, 오는 22일 선거관리 제도 개혁안을 도출할 계획이다.)

Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party’s ‘Convention Power Struggle’… Preferential Voting to Be Reconsidered (민주당 ‘전대 샅바싸움’…선호투표 다시 논의하기로)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has decided to revisit the introduction of preferential voting, which was set to replace the runoff voting system in the August 17 party convention leadership election. This appears to mark the beginning of a power struggle over the rules of the game before the convention. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에서 결선투표제 대신 도입하기로 한 선호투표제를 재논의하기로 했다. 전대 전 게임의 규칙을 두고 샅바 싸움이 시작된 모양새다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun stated after a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly on the 8th, “The Convention Preparatory Committee initially decided and announced the adoption of preferential voting, but some Supreme Council members have expressed differing opinions, so further discussion seems necessary. It will be reconsidered by the preparatory committee.” On the 7th, the preparatory committee announced the adoption of preferential voting—a system where voters rank all candidates in order of preference—instead of a runoff system. In this method, if no candidate secures a majority, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated first, and their second-preference votes are redistributed to the top two candidates to determine the final winner. (강준현 수석대변인은 8일 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의 뒤 “전당대회준비위원회(전준위)에서 일차적으로 선호투표제를 의결해 발표했는데 일부 최고위원의 이견이 있어서 논의를 더 해야 할 것 같다”며 “전준위에서 재논의할 예정”이라고 말했다. 전준위는 지난 7일 전당대회 유권자가 지지 후보 순위를 모두 적어 내는 방식의 선호투표제를 결선투표제 대신 도입하겠다고 발표했다. 선호투표제는 과반 득표자가 없을 경우 최하위 득표자를 우선 탈락시킨 뒤 그가 얻은 2순위 표를 1·2위 후보에게 합산해 최종 승리자를 가리는 방식이다.)

However, on the same day, former party leader Jeong Cheong-rae met with reporters at the National Assembly and said, “There are controversies that this violates the party’s constitution and rules. We cannot proceed while breaking the party constitution and rules. I have no intention of quarreling over election rules, but I hope the party convention preparatory committee or the Supreme Council will make a wise decision.” This marked a change in stance, as he had previously stated on the 7th that he would accept the preparatory committee’s decision. (그러나 이날 정청래 전 대표는 국회에서 취재진을 만나 “(선호투표제가) 당헌·당규 위반이라는 논란이 있다”며 “당헌·당규를 위반하면서 뭘 할 수는 없다. 경선 룰로 시비를 다툴 생각은 없지만, 이 부분은 당 전준위나 최고위원회에서 현명하게 결정하길 바란다”고 말했다. 전날 “전준위 결정을 수용한다”고 했지만 태도를 바꾼 것이다.)

Pro-Jeong Cheong-rae lawmakers also voiced opposition. Lawmaker Jo Seung-rae wrote on Facebook, “Introducing preferential voting for the party leadership election violates the party constitution and rules. The party constitution clearly states that a runoff vote must be held for the leadership election. To use preferential voting as a form of runoff, it should be included as a detailed clause under the runoff voting provision.” (친청계(친정청래계) 의원들도 반대 입장을 냈다. 조승래 의원은 페이스북에 “당대표 선출에 선호투표를 도입하는 건 당헌·당규 위반”이라며 “당헌·당규에는 (당대표 선거 시) ‘결선투표 실시’를 명기하고 있다. 선호투표를 결선투표의 한 방법으로 하려면 결선투표 조항의 세부 항목으로 넣어야 한다”고 적었다.)

Jeong’s shift in position appears to stem from a belief that preferential voting works to his disadvantage. One pro-Jeong lawmaker told The Hankyoreh, “There may have been political calculations behind the introduction of preferential voting. Anyone can see that former leader Jeong is the primary target.” With former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil sharing a support base, if supporters rank Kim and Song first and second, Jeong would inevitably be at a disadvantage. Lawmaker Ko Min-jung, who declared her candidacy for party leadership on the same day, also expressed opposition, stating, “Preferential voting creates a situation where it can only be suspected of being unfair.” (정 전 대표가 입장을 바꾼 건 선호투표제가 자신에게 불리하다는 판단을 했기 때문으로 보인다. 한 친청계 의원은 한겨레에 “(선호투표제 도입 배경에는) 정치 공학적 계산도 있었을 것”이라며 “누가 봐도 정 전 대표가 제1 타깃 아니냐”고 했다. 김민석 전 총리와 송영길 의원이 지지층을 공유하고 있는 만큼 이들이 1·2위에 김 전 총리와 송 의원을 적어 내면 정 전 대표가 불리할 수밖에 없다는 것이다. 이날 당대표 출마 선언을 한 고민정 의원도 “선호투표제는 불공정하다는 의심을 받을 수밖에 없는 상황을 연출한다”며 반대 뜻을 밝혔다.)

By Kim Chae-woon, staff reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Bill to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Rights' Sent to Judiciary Subcommittee… Rival Parties Clash Over Democrats' Full-Scale Discussion (‘보완수사권 폐지법’, 법사위 소위로…민주 논의 본격화에 국힘 반발)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has officially begun discussions on amending the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights. (더불어민주당이 검사의 보완수사권 폐지를 뼈대로 한 형사소송법 개정 논의에 본격 착수했다.)

On the 8th, the Democratic Party held a full session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, with the People Power Party boycotting, to propose and refer to a subcommittee amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act co-sponsored by Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min and Cho Kuk Innovation Party lawmaker Park Eun-jung, as well as another amendment sponsored by Innovation Party lawmaker Cha Gyu-geun. Both bills seek to abolish prosecutors' direct investigation rights and supplementary investigation rights, unifying investigation authority under the police (judicial police officers). (민주당은 8일 국민의힘이 불참한 가운데 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의를 열어 김용민 민주당 의원과 박은정 조국혁신당 의원이 공동 대표 발의한 형사소송법 개정안과 차규근 혁신당 의원이 대표 발의한 형사소송법 개정안을 상정한 뒤 소위원회에 넘겼다. 두 법안은 모두 검사의 직접수사권과 보완수사권을 폐지하고 경찰(사법경찰관)로 수사 주체를 일원화하는 내용을 담고 있다.)

Separately from the two bills submitted to the Judiciary Committee, the Democratic Party plans to introduce this week its own amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, drafted by an internal task force. The Judiciary Committee intends to conduct a consolidated review of these bills. Han Byeong-do, acting Democratic Party leader and floor leader, stated the previous day, "The complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights is a firm and unwavering principle of the Democratic Party, with no internal disagreement." However, some within the Democratic Party have raised concerns, with lawmaker Hong Ki-won noting, "Completely abolishing supplementary investigation rights could harm socially vulnerable individuals." (민주당은 법사위에 상정된 두 법안과는 별개로 당내 형사소송법 개정 티에프(TF)에서 만든 형사소송법 개정안을 이번주 중 발의할 예정이다. 법사위는 이들 법안을 병합심사 한다는 방침이다. 한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 전날 “보완수사권 완전 폐지는 민주당의 확고부동한 원칙이며 당내 이견이 없다”고 말했다. 다만 민주당 일각에서는 “보완수사권을 완전 폐지하면 사회적 약자가 피해를 입을 수 있다”(홍기원 의원)는 목소리도 나온다.)

The People Power Party strongly opposed the move. Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik met with Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho at the National Assembly, referencing the Gwangju high school student murder case, arguing, "Without the prosecution's supplementary investigation, this case would likely have been permanently covered up," and insisted on retaining supplementary investigation rights. Meanwhile, on the 7th, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office submitted an opinion to the National Assembly in favor of maintaining supplementary investigation rights, stating, "Supplementary investigation is not a prosecutor's privilege but a means and duty to protect citizens' fundamental human rights and prevent unjust victims from arising." (국민의힘은 강하게 반발했다. 정점식 원내대표는 국회에서 정성호 법무부 장관을 만나 광주 고교생 피살 사건을 언급하며 “검찰의 보완수사가 없었다면 이번 사건은 영원히 은폐됐을 가능성이 크다”며 보완수사권 존치를 주장했다. 한편 대검찰청은 지난 7일 “보완수사는 검사의 권한이 아니라 국민의 기본적 인권을 보호하고 억울한 피해자가 나오지 않게 하는 수단이자 책무”라며 보완수사권 유지 의견을 국회에 냈다.)

Reporters: Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr, Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr, Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr  정혜민 기자  jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Stock price manipulation will certainly be caught in the triple net of the Financial Supervisory Service, police, and prosecution" (이 대통령 “주가조작, 금감원·경찰·검찰 3중 그물에 반드시 걸려”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 8th, "Stock price manipulation will certainly be caught in the triple net of the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS), police, and prosecution." (이재명 대통령이 8일 “주가조작은 금융감독원·경찰·검찰의 3중 그물에 반드시 걸린다”고 말했다.)

President Lee shared a media report on X (formerly Twitter) that day about the FSS's Capital Market Special Judicial Police (SJP) conducting a raid and seizure of Maeil Business TV in connection with allegations of front-running by a securities broadcast host and guests. President Lee stated, "Fairness in the capital market is a value that cannot be abandoned." He also attached the hashtag 'stock price manipulation leads to ruin' to the post. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 금감원 자본시장특별사법경찰(특사경)이 증권 방송 진행자와 출연자의 선행매매 혐의와 관련해 매일경제티브이(TV)를 압수수색했다는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유하며 이렇게 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “자본시장 공정성은 포기할 수 없는 가치”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 해당 글에 ‘주가조작 패가망신’이라는 해시태그도 함께 달았다.)

It is understood that the FSS's SJP has captured circumstances where employees of Maeil Business TV, among others, used undisclosed positive information obtained during their work to pre-purchase specific stocks, then sold them after the stock price rose following the broadcast, reaping illegal gains. (금감원 특사경은 매일경제티브이 소속 직원 등이 업무 과정에서 얻은 미공개 호재성 정보를 이용해 특정 주식을 미리 사들인 뒤, 방송 이후 주가가 오르면 되팔아 부당이득을 챙긴 정황을 포착한 것으로 파악됐다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk, under pressure to resign, shifts to outside politics... Inside the party: "He's becoming like Yoon Suk-yeol and Hwang Kyo-ahn" (‘사퇴 압박’ 장동혁, 장외 정치 시동…당내선 “윤석열·황교안 닮아가”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, who is facing pressure to resign over responsibility for the June 3 local elections, has chosen "outside politics" as a political breakthrough. After the elections, Jang, who consistently attended rallies at Olympic Park, plans to tour the country to meet some hardcore supporters demanding a resolution to the ballot shortage crisis. (6·3 지방선거 책임론으로 사퇴 압박에 직면한 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 정치적 돌파구로 ‘장외 정치’를 택했다. 선거 뒤 올림픽공원 시위에 꾸준히 참석하던 장 대표는 투표용지 부족 사태 해결을 요구하는 일부 강성 지지층을 찾아 전국 곳곳을 순회한다는 방침이다.)

On the afternoon of the 8th, Jang attended a "Youth and College Student Discussion on the June 3 Disenfranchisement Incident" held at the People Power Party Incheon City Party office, stating, "A new beginning is needed so that the voices from Olympic Park can spread beyond Olympic Park across the entire country." Jang, who also joined the Olympic Park rally the previous night, said, "Despite the scorching heat and bad weather, many young people were holding firm at Olympic Park. On one hand, I am tearfully grateful, and on the other, I feel sorry." Following the discussion, Jang planned to visit a "Protect the Right to Vote" rally at Incheon Guwol Rodeo Plaza in the evening. Jang argued, "The main culprit behind creating such an irresponsible, incompetent, and arrogant National Election Commission is President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party of Korea," and also called for the appointment of a special prosecutor recommended by the People Power Party and the abolition of the early voting system. Jang plans to attend rallies related to the ballot shortage crisis held across the country. During the discussion, Jang said, "Starting with Incheon today, I plan to visit Busan, Gwangju, and then Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province." <<> Some within the party evaluate that Jang's actions resemble those of former leader Hwang Kyo-ahn, who abandoned parliamentary activities like proposing policy alternatives and focused solely on outside struggles. Rep. Lee Seong-kwon of the Alternative and Future, a group of young lawmakers, appeared on YTN's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" and said, "Looking into it, Jang Dong-hyuk's current line resembles President Yoon Suk-yeol's party management and national governance methods. And looking a bit further, it's exactly like former leader Hwang Kyo-ahn's behavior," adding, "In Hwang Kyo-ahn's case, he fell into the conspiracy theory of election fraud and engaged in strange political activities with strange parties." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 8일 오후 국민의힘 인천시당에서 열린 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태 청년·대학생 간담회’에 참석해 “올림픽공원의 목소리가 올림픽공원에만 머물지 않고 전국으로 퍼져나갈 수 있도록 새로운 시작이 필요하다”고 말했다. 전날 밤에도 올림픽공원 시위에 참석한 장 대표는 “무더위와 궂은 날씨에도 많은 청년들이 올림픽공원을 지키고 있었다”며 “한편으론 눈물 나게 고맙고 또 미안하기도 하다”고 말했다. 장 대표는 간담회에 이어 저녁에는 인천 구월로데오광장에서 ‘참정권 수호’ 집회 현장을 찾는다. 장 대표는 “이토록 무책임하고 무능하고 오만한 선거관리위원회를 만든 주범이 바로 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당”이라며 국민의힘이 추천한 특검 임명과 사전투표 제도 폐지도 주장했다. 장 대표는 앞으로 전국에서 열리는 투표용지 부족 사태 관련 집회에 참석할 계획이다. 장 대표는 이날 간담회에서 “오늘 인천을 시작으로 부산, 광주를 거쳐 대구, 경북도 방문하려 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Yoon meets Trump to discuss warship construction; also pushes for golf meeting (이 대통령, 트럼프 만나 ‘군함 건조’ 협의…골프 회동도 추진)
item.description:
President Yoon Seok-yeol, who is visiting Türkiye to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, met with U.S. President Donald Trump to hold follow-up discussions on the construction of military vessels. <<> Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung of the presidential office stated in a written briefing on the 8th (local time), "President Yoon attended a welcome dinner hosted by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and his wife on the evening of the 7th, where he met again with U.S. President Donald Trump, three weeks after their last meeting at the Group of Seven (G7) summit last month." <<> Regarding the construction of military vessels requested by President Trump at the G7 summit held in Évian, France last month, Senior Press Secretary Kang reported that President Yoon said, "I will cooperate as much as possible with President Trump's request," introducing our companies with excellent manufacturing capabilities. President Yoon had previously disclosed that President Trump asked, "Can you rapidly build 10 U.S. warships?" and this time, follow-up discussions addressed that matter. The two leaders agreed to continue working-level consultations to review specific plans. <<> Additionally, recalling the golf meeting promised during the G7 summit, the two leaders decided to promote President Yoon's visit to the U.S. at an appropriate time and to pursue a golf meeting on that occasion. <<> Earlier, President Yoon revealed on the 17th of last month that he had received a golf invitation from President Trump during the official dinner of the G7 summit. At that time, President Yoon posted a "selfie" with President Trump on X (formerly Twitter), stating, "We talked about golf at the dinner last night, and my wife made a pinky promise with him to play golf together. When we parted after lunch today, he said again that we should definitely play golf together. I thought it was just a passing remark, but it seems I need to prepare." <<> Seo Young-ji, reporter in Ankara: yj@hani.co.kr (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 참석을 위해 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 만나 군용 선박 건조와 관련한 후속 협의를 가졌다.)

item.title: President Lee and Zelenskyy "North Korean POW Issue to Be Resolved in Accordance with Parties' Intentions and International Law"... First Summit Meeting (이 대통령·젤렌스키 “북한군 포로, 당사자 의사·국제법 부합하게 해결”…첫 정상회담)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Türkiye to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, held his first summit meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the 8th (local time) and discussed the reconstruction of Ukraine and the issue of North Korean prisoners of war. (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 참석을 위해 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 8일(현지시각) 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과 첫 정상회담을 열고 우크라이나 재건과 북한군 포로 문제 등을 논의했다.)

At the first summit meeting in Ankara, Türkiye, President Lee emphasized, "Our government will continue to provide the humanitarian aid that the Ukrainian people need, while also continuing to participate in international efforts to restore and rebuild Ukraine," according to a written briefing from Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jeong. The previous day, President Lee met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte and pledged comprehensive support worth 100 million dollars (approximately 150 billion won) for Ukraine's reconstruction. A senior official from the presidential office, when asked by reporters the previous day about the specific details of the support, stated, "We will provide continuous support in other areas, excluding lethal weapons." (이 대통령은 이날 튀르키예 앙카라에서 젤렌스키 대통령과 첫 정상회담에서 “우리 정부는 우크라이나 국민들이 필요로 하는 인도적 지원을 지속하면서 우크라이나 복구·재건을 위한 국제사회의 노력에도 지속 동참해 나갈 것”이라고 강조했다고 강유정 수석대변인이 서면브리핑을 통해 전했다. 이 대통령은 전날 마르크 뤼터 나토 사무총장을 만나 우크라이나 재건을 위해 1억달러(약 1500억원) 규모의 포괄적 지원을 약속했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 구체적인 지원 내역과 관련해 전날 기자들과 만나 “살상 무기를 제외하고 다른 영역에서 지속적인 지원을 해나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

In response, President Zelenskyy expressed gratitude for the support from the South Korean government and replied, "I hope to continue close cooperation with the international community, including South Korea, for the swift end of the war and the peace and recovery of Ukraine," according to Senior Press Secretary Kang. He also expressed expectations for the continued participation of the South Korean government and companies in the reconstruction process of Ukraine. (이에 젤렌스키 대통령은 우리 정부의 지원에 감사의 뜻을 전하며 “전쟁의 조속한 종식 및 우크라이나의 평화와 회복을 위해 앞으로도 한국을 포함한 국제사회와 긴밀히 협력해 나가기를 희망한다”고 화답했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. 그러면서 우크라이나 재건 과정에서 한국 정부와 기업들의 지속적인 참여도 기대한다고 밝혔다.)

Additionally, the two leaders discussed the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine. Senior Press Secretary Kang said, "The two leaders agreed to resolve the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine by respecting the free will of the parties in a manner consistent with international law and humanitarian principles." Two North Korean soldiers, who were deployed to Russia, were captured by Ukraine and have both expressed their wish to go to South Korea. The South Korean government has maintained a stance that it will accept all North Korean prisoners of war who wish to come to South Korea. (아울러 양국 정상은 우크라이나 내 북한군 포로 문제도 논의했다. 강 수석대변인은 “양 정상은 우크라이나 내 북한군 포로 문제는 당사자들의 자유의사를 존중하여 국제법과 인도주의 원칙에 부합하는 방식으로 해결해 나가기로 뜻을 모았다”고 말했다. 러시아에 파병됐던 북한군 포로 2명은 우크라이나에 의해 생포됐으며, 현재 모두 한국행 의사를 밝혔다. 정부는 북한군 포로가 한국행을 희망하면, 모두 수용하겠다는 입장을 보여왔다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji from Ankara yj@hani.co.kr (앙카라/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Pushes for Swift Abolition of Prosecutorial Supplementary Investigation Powers… but ‘Thorough Deliberation’ Caution Also Emerges (민주, 보완수사권 폐지 속도전…“심도있는 숙의” 신중론도)
item.description:
<<>> With a bill to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers submitted to the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee plenary session on the 8th, cautious voices are emerging even within the ruling party, which had adopted a strategy of moving quickly. <<> At the Legislation and Judiciary Committee meeting held at the National Assembly that afternoon, two bills were introduced: one co-sponsored by Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min and Cho Kuk Innovation Party lawmaker Park Eun-jung, and another sponsored independently by Innovation Party lawmaker Cha Kyu-geun. Both bills call for entirely abolishing prosecutors' direct investigation powers and supplementary investigation powers, and unifying investigative authority under judicial police officers. <<> Although the meeting was attended only by lawmakers from the Democratic Party and the Innovation Party, with the People Power Party absent, differences in opinion emerged over the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers. Lawmaker Kim Yong-min emphasized the need for swift processing, stating, “We have only 86 days left until the abolition of the prosecution service (on October 2). The separation of investigation and indictment can never be a subject of compromise.” In contrast, Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Nam-hee stressed the need for thorough preparations, saying, “Even in the process of reform, no investigative agency should wield unchecked power. We must not ignore the desperate plea of the bereaved family of Lee Chae-won, a victim in the Jang Yun-gi case, who said, ‘There must be no more unjust deaths.’” Lawmaker Park Eun-jung argued, “Prosecution reform is about solving structural problems. We should not address this case by granting investigation powers to prosecutors.” Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho, who attended the meeting, stated, “The separation of investigation and indictment (the government and ruling party's key principle for prosecution reform) must be upheld,” adding, “Cross-verification of (judicial police) investigations is necessary, so I ask the National Assembly to discuss this in depth.” <<> As all candidates in the August 17 party leadership race uniformly called for swift processing, open opinions within the party also emerged calling for ‘deliberation.’ Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok appeared on the YouTube broadcast “Kim Eo-joon’s Humility is Difficult News Factory” and set a timeline, saying, “The party should proceed as quickly as possible and, if possible, finish (the legal amendment) even by the end of July.” Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae met with reporters at the National Assembly and emphasized, “If internal disagreements are exposed, it could cast doubt on the principle of separating investigation and indictment. I hope there will be no further controversy within the party over the complete abolition.” Amidst this, two-term lawmaker Hong Ki-won wrote on Facebook, “We should consider whether there is room to retain a supplementary investigation powers at a level that minimizes unjust victims, and this requires a process of in-depth deliberation. This deliberation should not be a pre-decided one, but rather a search for the optimal solution.” <<> The Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill is scheduled to be discussed again on the 10th at the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's First Subcommittee on Bill Review. Separately from the bills proposed by lawmakers like Kim, the Democratic Party is also working on its own amendment through a task force (TF) established within the party to revise the Criminal Procedure Act. The TF plans to propose its amendment within this week. Subsequently, it is expected that the proposed amendments will be reviewed jointly by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee alongside the already-submitted lawmakers' bills. <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: Song Young-gil Declares Candidacy with "Lee Shim Song Shim, Party-Administration Unity" Slogan... Ko Min-jung Joins with "Young Democratic Party" (송영길 “이심송심·당청동색” 출사표…고민정 “젊은 민주당” 가세)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, threw his hat into the ring for the party leadership race on August 8, championing the slogan "Lee Shim Song Shim" (meaning Rep. Song Young-gil's will aligns with President Lee Jae-myung's will). Ko Min-jung, a former spokesperson for the Moon Jae-in administration's presidential office, also declared her candidacy for party leader that day, promoting a "young Democratic Party." The party convention will now be a four-way race involving these two, along with former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. <<> On this day, at the party members' zone in the Democratic Party office in Yeouido, Seoul, Rep. Song stated, "This party convention is not an election to pick who is more distinct, but to choose a representative who will cooperate with the Lee Jae-myung administration to create an irreplaceable Republic of Korea." He added, "I will create a true ruling party that unites tightly and moves as one for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The era's task the party should focus on most is turning the Democratic Party into a structurally majority party through the power of 'Lee Shim Song Shim' and 'party-administration unity.'" He criticized former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, saying, "The June 3 election was a defeat wrapped in the guise of victory," and argued, "The president should not have to walk a thorny path alone." This emphasized party-administration alignment, distinguishing himself from former Rep. Jeong. <<> Rep. Song highlighted youth policies, stating, "Without the support of the 2030 generation, there will be no presidential election in 2030," and pledged to appoint two ex-officio supreme council members from the youth, create a 2030 special committee and platform to allow young people direct participation in key party decisions. <<> Rep. Ko, a pro-Moon figure, also held a press conference at the National Assembly's communication hall, challenging the party leadership race by saying, "We need to change the party's signboard. How long will we keep pushing the 86 group to the forefront and only follow them?" She warned, "If we remain mired in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to people's lives, winning the general election or reclaiming power will become difficult," urging, "We must stop stigmatizing and using derogatory language, acknowledge and communicate with opponents, and seek alternatives." Ko promised measures like youth quota appointments within the party and a youth future committee under the party leader, declaring, "I will forge a path for a young Democratic Party that listens to youth voices externally and nurtures youth internally." <<> With a preliminary primary (cutoff) scheduled for August 21 to narrow down candidates to three, the strategies for each contender are complex. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who declared his candidacy on August 6, and Rep. Song, who is expected to form an "anti-Jeong Cheong-rae alliance," are signaling their intent to "complete the race." <<> Amid all three male candidates—former PM Kim, former Rep. Jeong, and Rep. Song—being considered representatives of the "386 generation," the 40-something female contender Rep. Ko could influence support for former Rep. Jeong. A pro-Moon lawmaker commented, "Rep. Ko may not be representing the pro-Moon group entirely, but some support from traditional voter bases might shift from Jeong to Ko. However, passing the preliminary primary is key." <<> Meanwhile, former PM Kim and former Rep. Jeong continued their verbal sparring over the "self-politics" frame. Appearing on the YouTube show "Kim Eo-joon's Humility is Hard, News Factory," former PM Kim criticized former Rep. Jeong, citing the merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party as an example of "self-politics," saying, "It was a highly volatile issue requiring political judgment, but it was handled with a bombshell declaration, ruining everything." On this day, former PM Kim visited the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City, touring the Mokpo traditional market and regional committees, followed by a youth forum. Former Rep. Jeong hosted a policy debate at the National Assembly on "Success of the Southwest Semiconductor Cluster," courting support from the Honam region. When asked by reporters about "plans to boost youth support," former Rep. Jeong responded, "The party must embrace and actively resolve the employment and housing issues facing the 2030 generation." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol: sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-ju: goh@hani.co.kr (송영길 더불어민주당 의원이 8일 “이심송심”(이재명 대통령의 뜻이 곧 송영길 의원의 뜻)을 내세우며 8·17 전당대회 당대표 출사표를 던졌다. 문재인 정부 청와대 대변인을 지낸 고민정 의원도 “젊은 민주당”을 앞세워 이날 당대표 출마를 선언했다. 민주당 전대는 두 사람과 함께 김민석 전 국무총리, 정청래 전 대표의 4파전 구도로 치러지게 됐다.)

item.title: Korea-Romania Summit… President Lee: "Progress in Defense Cooperation Holds Special Significance" (한-루마니아 정상회담…이 대통령 “방산협력 진전, 특별한 의미”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Türkiye to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, met with Romanian President Klaus Iohannis on the 8th (local time) to discuss cooperation in the defense industry and other sectors. (북대서양조약기구(나토·NATO) 정상회의 참석을 위해 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 8일(현지시각) 니쿠쇼르 단 루마니아 대통령을 만나 방위산업 분야 등에 대한 협력을 논의했다.)

During the Korea-Romania summit held in Ankara, Türkiye, President Lee stated, "For South Korea, Romania is a truly important cooperation partner," adding, "We are seeing progress in trade as well as in the defense industry, and I believe the local production of the K9 self-propelled howitzer is particularly significant." (이 대통령은 이날 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열린 한-루마니아 정상회담에서 “대한민국에 루마니아는 정말로 중요한 협력 파트너”라며 “교역을 포함해 방위산업 분야에서도 진전이 이뤄지고 있고, 특히 케이(K)9 (자주포)현지생산을 하게 됐다는 점이 특별히 의미가 있다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "In the defense industry, our focus is not just on transactional trade relationships for buying and selling goods, but on achieving substantive cooperation that involves joint development, joint production, and entering third-country markets together." He added, "I hope Mr. President will also visit South Korea to strengthen our practical cooperation." President Lee also joked, "I need to go and experience for myself whether there really is a Dracula," prompting laughter from both leaders. (이 대통령은 “방위산업에 있어서 물건을 사고파는 거래적 관계가 아니라 함께 개발도 하고 공동생산을 하고 제3세계에 함께 진출하는 그런 실질적인 협력이 이뤄진다는 것에 우리는 주안점을 두고 있다”며 “우리 대통령님께서 한국도 방문해주셔서 실질적인 협력을 강화하면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “특히 드라큘라가 있는지 제가 체험하러 가봐야 한다”고 농담을 건네 두 정상이 웃음을 터트리기도 했다.)

In response, President Iohannis said, "Bilateral relations are very good, and we are seeing many interesting investments," noting, "South Korean companies are participating in the refurbishment projects of two nuclear power plants in Romania, and we are also promoting the construction of two new nuclear power plants." He continued, "I think there will be many new opportunities for economic cooperation between our two countries," and expressed, "I sincerely hope the President will visit Romania." (이에 단 대통령은 “양국관계가 매우 좋고, 흥미로운 투자도 많이 이뤄지고 있다”며 “루마니아에 있는 2개 원전에서의 개보수 사업과 관련해 한국 기업들이 참여하고 있고, 2개의 신규원전 건설 사업도 추진하고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 그는 “양국간의 경제 협력에서 새로운 기회들이 여러가지 있을 것 같다”며 “대통령께서 루마니아를 꼭 방문해주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee holds follow-up talks with Trump on ‘warship construction’… Discusses North Korean prisoners with Zelenskyy (이 대통령, 트럼프와 ‘군함 건조’ 후속 협의…젤렌스키와 북한군 포로 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, in his first summit with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the 8th (local time), agreed to resolve the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine according to the will of the individuals involved and international law. On the 7th, President Lee met with U.S. President Donald Trump at a dinner hosted by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and his spouse, holding follow-up discussions on the construction of military vessels requested by Trump. (이재명 대통령이 8일(현지시각) 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과의 첫 정상회담에서 우크라이나 내 북한군 포로 문제를 당사자 자유의사와 국제법에 따라 해결해 나가기로 했다. 이 대통령은 7일에는 레제프 타이이프 에르도안 튀르키예 대통령 내외 주최 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 만나 그가 요청한 군용 선박 건조와 관련한 후속 협의를 했다.)

President Lee, who is visiting Turkey to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, held a summit with President Zelenskyy at a hotel in Ankara on this day. Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung reported via a written briefing, “We agreed to resolve the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine in a manner that respects the free will of the individuals involved and aligns with international law and humanitarian principles.” Two North Korean soldiers, who were dispatched to Russia and captured by Ukrainian forces, have expressed their desire to go to South Korea. (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 참석차 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이 대통령은 이날 앙카라의 한 호텔에서 젤렌스키 대통령과 정상회담을 하고 “우크라이나 내 북한군 포로 문제는 당사자들의 자유의사를 존중해 국제법과 인도주의 원칙에 부합하는 방식으로 해결해 나가기로 뜻을 모았다”고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 서면 브리핑을 통해 전했다. 러시아에 파병됐다가 우크라이나군에 생포된 북한군 포로 2명은 한국행을 원하고 있다.)

The two leaders also agreed to cooperate on post-war reconstruction projects in Ukraine. Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, “President Lee explained that he announced a comprehensive support commitment of $100 million (approximately 150 billion won) for Ukraine on the occasion of this NATO summit, and emphasized that our government will continue to provide the humanitarian aid needed by the Ukrainian people while also joining international efforts for Ukraine’s recovery and reconstruction.” The previous day, President Lee met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte and pledged $100 million in support for Ukraine’s reconstruction. A senior official from the presidential office told reporters the day before, “We will exclude lethal weapons and continue support in other areas.” (두 사람은 전후 우크라이나 재건 사업에도 협력하기로 했다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 대통령은 이번 나토 정상회의를 계기로 우크라이나에 대한 1억달러(약 1500억원) 포괄 지원 공약을 발표했음을 설명하고, 우리 정부는 우크라이나 국민들이 필요로 하는 인도적 지원을 지속하면서 우크라이나 복구·재건을 위한 국제사회의 노력에도 지속 동참해 나갈 것이라고 강조했다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 전날 마르크 뤼터 나토 사무총장을 만나 우크라이나 재건을 위해 1억달러 규모의 지원을 약속했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 전날 기자들과 만나 “살상무기는 제외하고 여타 영역에서 지속적인 지원을 해나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang also reported that President Lee met with President Trump the previous day and discussed the construction of military vessels requested by Trump. “President Lee expressed his willingness to cooperate as much as possible with President Trump’s request and introduced our companies with excellent shipbuilding capabilities,” Kang said. “The two leaders agreed to continue working-level consultations to review specific plans.” The two also agreed to arrange President Lee’s visit to the U.S. at an appropriate time, and to play a round of golf on that occasion. (이 대통령은 전날에는 트럼프 대통령과 만나 그가 요청한 군용 선박 건조에 대해서도 논의를 했다고 강 수석대변인이 전했다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 트럼프 대통령의 요청에 최대한 협조하겠다면서 우수한 선박 제조 역량을 가진 우리 기업을 소개했다”며 “두 정상은 구체 방안을 검토하기 위한 실무 협의를 이어가기로 했다”고 말했다. 두 사람은 적절한 시기에 이 대통령의 방미를 추진하고, 그 계기에 골프 라운딩도 하기로 했다.)

Meanwhile, in addition to the summit with Ukraine, President Lee held a series of bilateral meetings with leaders of NATO member states, including Norway and Romania, on this day, engaging in ‘defense sales.’ In particular, President Lee agreed with Secretary General Rutte the previous day to begin negotiations for the conclusion of a ‘Korea-NATO Procurement Basic Agreement.’ National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated in a local briefing, “If the agreement is signed, it will lay the groundwork for our companies to participate in the NATO joint procurement market, which is expected to be worth 15 trillion won annually.” (한편 이 대통령은 이날 우크라이나 정상회담 외에도 노르웨이, 루마니아 등 나토 회원국 정상들과도 잇따라 양자 회담을 하며 ‘방산 세일즈’에 나섰다. 특히 이 대통령은 전날 뤼터 사무총장과 ‘한-나토 조달기본협정’ 체결을 위한 협상을 개시하기로 했다. 위성락 국가안보실장은 현지 브리핑에서 “협정이 체결되면 연 15조원으로 예상되는 나토 공동조달 시장에 우리 기업들이 참여할 수 있는 기반이 마련될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Ankara/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (앙카라/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
